{{Top|leg}}
A '''reclamation cruiser''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] used by [[Squib/Legends|Squibs]]. The [[Two-For-One|''Two-for-One'']] was a reclamation [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] which visited [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] before [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], and left without her [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]], [[Macemillian-winduarté]].
